title: S-Function Examples
text: Include S-function in model, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {S-function parameters} sets Additional S-function parameters MATLAB expressions; {S-function name} sets the name and {S-function modules} sets the additional files for code generation. Values come from the instance.
